title: Camera zoom band 1.0..4.0 restated as literals in three parsers while CAM_ZOOM_MIN/MAX constants exist
evidence: harness/main.odin:212: `if !okz || !(z >= 1.0 && z <= 4.0) { // the NaN-rejecting band test (demo-parser parity)` | harness/motion_strip.odin:114: `if zoom_override >= 1.0 && zoom_override <= 4.0 {` | harness/demo.odin:643: `if !okz || !(z >= 1.0 && z <= 4.0) { // the NaN-rejecting band test (z < 1.0 is false for NaN)` | app/render/camera.odin:28,34: `CAM_ZOOM_MIN :: 1.0` / `CAM_ZOOM_MAX :: 4.0` | camera.odin:291-293: "zoom_rung_of — the rung for an effective zoom (pure, deterministic). One derivation: camera_update (the app path) and the harness demo-zoom path both call this — a restated copy would drift a rung cut."
detail: The diff adds two more literal copies of the zoom band next to demo.odin's, contradicting the repo's own one-derivation doctrine stated on zoom_rung_of 20 lines from CAM_ZOOM_MAX. A future CAM_ZOOM_MAX retune silently leaves the parsers on the old band.
recommended_fix: Compare against rnd.CAM_ZOOM_MIN/rnd.CAM_ZOOM_MAX in main.odin, motion_strip.odin and demo.odin (add the rnd import to main.odin) so the camera band has one definition.

title: palcheck §8 routed-branch legs write crisis.pipe_congestion without the testing_lvl_ok guard the other legs use
evidence: Legs (a)-(c): `if testing_lvl_ok {` then `state.crisis.pipe_congestion[ps8] = .Amber`. Resize guard: `if testing_lvl_ok && int(ps8) >= len(state.crisis.pipe_congestion) {`. Legs (d)+(e), unguarded: `view.route_wires = true` … `state.crisis.pipe_congestion[ps8] = .Amber`. core/warnings.odin:52: `c.pipe_congestion = make([dynamic]Congestion_Level, 0, 8, allocator)` (len 0; crisis_make called from run_init, core/types.odin:575).
detail: If the fixture premise fails (ok_ps or found_bi false) the resize is skipped and legs (d)+(e) index an empty array — an out-of-range panic crashes palcheck instead of reporting the premise failure with its cause.
recommended_fix: Wrap the (d)+(e) block body in `if testing_lvl_ok { ... }` matching legs (a)-(c), so a broken fixture degrades to the recorded premise failure.

title: Halo blend restated in both draw_bundles branches while the diff unifies only the width law
evidence: view.odin:719-721: "congested_halo_width — the A1 emphasis law, ONE derivation for both draw_bundles branches (a restated copy drifts the look between the blessed inline path and the routed variant)" | view.odin:1025-1027 and 1102-1104 (identical triples): `u8(f32(raw.r) * 0.57 + f32(halo.r) * 0.43),` | harness/palcheck.odin:1407-1409: `u8(f32(raw.r) * 0.57 + f32(state_col.r) * 0.43),`
detail: The diff applies its stated drift rationale to the width but leaves the raw×0.57+state×0.43 blend duplicated in both branches (plus a fixture copy); a one-branch blend change drifts the look the unification exists to prevent.
